shell_commands:
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch
sed -n '1,180p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorUsage.test.ts
sed -n '1,150p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorUsage.acceptance.test.ts
sed -n '1,220p' specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md
sed -n '1,160p' CHANGELOG.md
sed -n '1,180p' .lore/test-commands.yml
ls scripts/spec-links 2>/dev/null || true
cat package.json"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git log --oneline -5 --decorate
git show --stat --oneline HEAD
git diff origin/main...HEAD -- src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorUsage.test.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorUsage.acceptance.test.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md CHANGELOG.md .lore/dod.md'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'timeout 300 npm run spec:names -- --fix
npx prettier --write .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md CHANGELOG.md
git status --short
git diff --check
git diff -- .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md CHANGELOG.md src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorUsage.test.ts'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorUsage.test.ts && git commit -m "docs: anchor aggregate usage acceptance" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status --short --branch'
